# Risk Acceptance / Exception Request

| Field                    | Value |
|--------------------------|-------|
| Exception ID             | RA-YYYY-NNN |
| Type                     | FP / OR / VD / RA (see security-review-policy.md §4) |
| Finding(s)               | Scanner ID / CVE / review finding + affected component |
| Original severity        | |
| Adjusted severity (if RA)| |
| Environment(s)           | |
| Requested by             | |
| Expires                  | (≤ 90 days) |

## Description
What the finding is, in plain language.

## Justification / Evidence
Why it doesn't apply, can't be fixed, or deserves a different severity.
Link evidence.

## Compensating controls
What reduces the risk in the meantime.

## Remediation plan
What will close the finding, who owns it, and by when.
